sonnet.problem: This True statement restates card 12, which sits right before it. Card 12 already covered the LORD confusing the builders' language, and this card uses that same answer ('language') and makes the same point. It re-asks one fact as two questions.
sonnet.rule: A True statement never just repeats the card before it. ... An easy follow-up asks something new. It never re-asks the same fact. Two lines that make the same point get one question. An answer shown on one card, right or wrong, isn't used again on a later card.

sonnet.problem: The blank's answer, 'language', is already given by earlier cards. Card 1 says 'one language', card 10 quotes 'speaking the same language', and card 11's question repeats it. The baker can fill the blank without reasoning about the verse.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.
